profile_text.body:
Salesforce is a publicly traded software company, founded in 1999 and headquartered in San Francisco, CA, that provides customer relationship management and enterprise collaboration platforms. Its Slack subsidiary operates a widely used workplace messaging product, and the company reported revenue of $41,525,000,000 for the fiscal year ending January 31, 2026, under the ticker CRM.

On the AI front, Salesforce tracks three principal products. Slack AI is embedded directly in the Slack messaging platform and the company describes it as offering channel and thread summaries, daily recaps, AI-powered search, meeting note-taking, workflow automation, and inline message translation. The site states that customer data is not used to train the underlying large language models and that those models are hosted within Slack's AWS virtual private cloud. Slack also serves as the conversational interface for Agentforce, the company's broader CRM-embedded AI and autonomous agent platform, allowing Agentforce agents to operate inside Slack channels, threads, and direct messages. A third product, Tableau AI (branded with Einstein), brings natural language querying and AI capabilities to Salesforce's business intelligence tooling, with a noted Trust Layer governance component.

The held facts show no litigation on record for Salesforce in this registry. Several third-party Model Context Protocol servers have been registered in connection with Salesforce, covering SOQL-based data querying against Salesforce orgs, general Salesforce administration, and Salesforce DevOps pipeline management, indicating developer ecosystem activity around programmatic access to Salesforce data and infrastructure.
